svg.aria-label: High level architecture of the Power BI report fix, grouped by tool. Source files: sales_flat.csv, the flat export in data/input/, 2,098,633 rows and 35 columns, written by prepare_data.py in the demo. Python and DuckDB: config.py checks client.yaml and the 11 mapped columns; analysis.ipynb works out the check numbers in DuckDB SQL and writes output/sales.csv with 11 columns. Power BI Desktop: Power Query (the Sales Flat staging query feeds Sales, Customer and Product), the data model (a star of 1 fact and 3 dimensions, Date with 3,653 days built in DAX, 3 one-to-many relationships) and DAX (10 measures, no calculated columns). Report: the fixed report sales-after.pbip, 2 pages and 19 visuals; the slow report sales-before.pbip reads sales_flat.csv as is, with 35 plus 6 calculated columns.
svg.title: High Level Architecture
